provenance.author: Larry Klosowski + Claude Opus 5.5
provenance.purpose: HUP-S1.10 injection eval set v2 (A50): injection-v1 unchanged plus fragment files. Adds the MCP-output and browser-snapshot vectors WP S1.10 names; those cases are live: the poisoned content reaches the model through a real sidecar session (the runtime's MCP stdio fixture server, and the managed headless browser on a loopback page), scored deterministically from the session's events. No model-as-judge.
provenance.note: Eval provenance (planset 05 'Eval provenance'): this set MUST stay disjoint from any E9 training trajectories. Never copy these prompts into a training set. v2 = every v1 item unchanged (via includes) plus the fragment files in the .d directory; a lane that adds a tool adds a NEW fragment file. Never edit v1 (its bytes are pinned) and never edit a fragment another lane owns: changing an item means a new version.
